paragraphs: Black Friday is probably the best time to buy Apple gear, as prices typically hit their lowest of the year. So, if you are in the market for a new MacBook or iPad, now is the time to pull the trigger.
The best Black Friday Apple deals are already live at Amazon, Best Buy and B&H Photo, with prices dropping by several hundred dollars.
This post contains affiliate links. Cult of Mac may earn a commission when you use our links to buy items.

Whether you’re looking for a new MacBook, an iPad or a pair of AirPods, there are plenty of deals to choose from. Below, we rounded up the best offers across Apple’s lineup, along with where to shop for the lowest prices.
As usual, the prices keep fluctuating. If you don’t see the deal mentioned below, check back after a few hours.
The M5 MacBook Air is $250 off at both Amazon and Best Buy across every configuration. B&H can’t match this deal.
Apple’s cheapest Mac is even cheaper for Black Friday, with a sweet $50 off.
B&H has the best price on the base M6 MacBook Pro. It lists the machine at $1,849, but an extra $50 coupon applied in the cart takes it down to $1,799.
